description: Create a NEW private draft character/enemy from a completed creature analysis and optional corrected anatomy. Blender builds the skeleton, surface-smoothed skin weights and procedural starting/diagnostic clips. Grounded leg chains get in-place walk/run with IK. Returns job_id; poll gripforge_generation_read for the Character Studio link, skinned GLB, editable .blend, anatomy and deformation report. Never automatically replaces or validates the source. Every anatomy proposal requires explicit review; use generation_cancel/retry to control durable work. Finger/facial authoring and finished combat choreography are outside v1. 0 GripForge credits.

allow_rerig.description: Explicitly create a NEW rigged copy if the source already contains bones. The source is never overwritten.

profile.description: Optional corrected anatomy in the exact coordinate system returned by analyze. Read the schema and inspect the multiview preview first.

reviewed_anatomy.description: Required: true only after inspecting/correcting the anatomy and its skeleton overlay.
